Title: Order Management Application Developer
Location: Bellevue, WA
Duration: 6 months

 The below requisition is a contract position on W2. 

Scope of Work: 
1. Perform Analysis and Requirement Handling 
2. Design, implement, document, and maintain various modules within Concept Wave Order Management/EPC module with SAP CRM, WSIL & BSCS modules 
3. Identify areas of improvements to current design and advocates alternative method to enhance current working set 
4. Design, Debug, analyze and resolve complex database engine problems of customers 
5. Work with engineering team in different geographic locations to diagnose and resolve design issues and customer reported problems 
6. Articulate technical information clearly. Provide training and assist on knowledge transfer 
7. Prioritize tasks, develops detailed design, and estimate effort required to completion of projects
8. Follow the software development cycle from inception and requirement to successful release of product
9. Develops and continually updates knowledge about the technical infrastructure and applications in use.
